fieldNotes.truckGate: Fenced secured plant superblock; chain-link perimeter confirmed in Street View on the north drive. Continuous internal perimeter drive with no public-road open driveway visible; access is via a private gated connection. A controlled gate is inferred from the fenced, solar-roofed Kroger production plant context, but no gate arm was directly resolved in imagery (Street View cannot reach the truck entrance).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth resolvable in satellite or in the reachable Street View panos. Set false; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true (gate inferred, no booth confirmed) implying kiosk/app check-in; low-confidence pairing with truckGate.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimated from south-face apron and east-end trailer banks; ~30 doors across the south and east faces, band 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Row of drop trailers along the west internal road plus trailers in the south yard; dedicated trailer storage present.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide south truck apron and a large undeveloped west lot give ample paved/expandable width for a bypass lane.
fieldNotes.railServed: A single N-S rail track runs along the east property edge but no spur diverges into the plant; set false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense La Habra industrial fabric surrounded by warehouses and residential; Urban.
